quests.name: Charsi's Imbue
quests.description: After giving Charsi the Horadric Malus, present an eligible normal weapon or armor unchanged. Claim a separate Imbue charge, then choose which item to imbue.

objectives.description: Present an eligible normal weapon or armor to Charsi without consuming it.

quests.name: Kashya's Recruit
quests.description: Defeat Blood Raven and return to Kashya. In Normal, explicitly enlist a Rogue Scout — Trainee, then separately Claim one-time ensure-owned support in your journal.

objectives.description: Enlist or re-enlist a Rogue Scout — Trainee at Kashya.

quests.name: Cain's Gratitude
quests.description: For rescuing him from the ruined village in the Dark Wood, Cain offers to identify your unidentified items free of charge for the rest of your journey.

objectives.description: Speak with Cain in the Rogue Encampment.

quests.name: Gheed's Salvage Deal
quests.description: Gheed sees value in five marked salvage lots in the Cold Plains. Recover each on Normal, then Claim in Quests to exchange all five for 1,000 XP and 1 Gem Shard.

objectives.description: Recover 5 distinct Gheed salvage lots in the Cold Plains on Normal.

quests.name: Whispers of the Cow King
quests.description: Recover Wirt's Leg after clearing the Dark Wood on Normal. At Akara, Receive a bound Portal Tome and transmute both with the retained Horadric Cube. Enter the hidden clearing for one Cow King battle, then Claim 6,000 XP separately after victory.

objectives.description: Recover Wirt's Leg from his remains after clearing the Dark Wood on Normal.
At Akara, transmute Wirt's Leg and the bound portal Tome using the retained Horadric Cube.

quests.name: Greiz's Roster
quests.description: After completing Radament's Lair, heroes of level 12 or higher can explicitly enlist a Desert Merc — Blessed Aim at Greiz in Normal. Separately Claim one-time ensure-owned support in your journal.

objectives.description: Enlist or re-enlist a Desert Merc — Blessed Aim at Greiz.

quests.name: Fara's Favor
quests.description: After completing Radament's Lair, speak with Fara in Lut Gholein. Claim 1 gem-shard separately in Quests. For one gem fusion, supply 3 matching gems of the same type and quality; the shard covers its catalyst cost.

objectives.description: Speak with Fara.

quests.name: The Lost Caravan
quests.description: Recover Elzix's Strongbox in the Far Oasis on Normal. Keep it as a memento and claim XP and The Eye of Etlich separately in Quests.

objectives.description: Recover Elzix's Strongbox in the Far Oasis.

quests.name: Drognan's Tome
quests.description: Recover the Sun-Cult Tome in the Lost City. Drognan will share its arcane knowledge; claim XP and a skill point separately in Quests.

objectives.description: Find the Sun-Cult Tome.

quests.name: Horazon's Lockbox
quests.description: Recover Horazon's Lockbox in the Arcane Sanctuary on Normal. Keep it as a memento and claim XP and Manald Heal separately in Quests.

objectives.description: Recover Horazon's Lockbox in the Arcane Sanctuary.

quests.name: Asheara's Iron Wolves
quests.description: With Act III unlocked, heroes of level 18 or higher can explicitly enlist an Iron Wolf — Frozen Armor at Asheara in Normal. Separately Claim one-time ensure-owned support in your journal.

objectives.description: Enlist or re-enlist an Iron Wolf — Frozen Armor at Asheara.

quests.name: Alkor's Experiment
quests.description: Recover three distinct venom glands in the Spider Forest on Normal. Claim in your journal to exchange all three for XP and five unallocated stat points.

objectives.description: Recover 3 venom glands in the Spider Forest.

quests.name: Jade Figurine Buyer
quests.description: Recover three distinct jade trinkets in Kurast Bazaar on Normal. Give all three to Meshif in Kurast, then separately Claim XP and 1,000 rune shards in your journal.

objectives.description: Recover 3 jade trinkets in Kurast Bazaar and give them to Meshif.

quests.name: Ormus's Charm
quests.description: Clear every wave of the Flayer Jungle on Normal in a manual run, then speak with Ormus in Kurast. Claim his enchanted charm, which grants +20 Life and +10 Mana while equipped in your charm slot.

objectives.description: Clear every wave of the Flayer Jungle on Normal in a manual run.
Return to Kurast and speak with Ormus.

quests.name: Tyrael's Blessing
quests.description: Having freed Izual's soul, Tyrael grants you an extra skill point and reflects upon Heaven's regret for the Fallen Angel.

objectives.description: Receive Tyrael's blessing.

quests.name: Jamella's Stockpile
quests.description: Recover five distinct Forge Embers in the River of Flame on Normal. Claim in your journal to exchange all five for XP and one perfect gem.

objectives.description: Recover 5 Forge Embers in the River of Flame.

quests.name: Halbu's Soulwork
quests.description: Halbu, the angelic armorer, offers to socket a piece of armor for those who shattered Mephisto's soulstone.

objectives.description: Bring an item to Halbu.

quests.name: Larzuk's Hammer
quests.description: Larzuk the smith will socket one of your items as thanks for breaking Shenk's siege.

objectives.description: Bring an item to Larzuk to socket.

quests.name: Anya's Gift
quests.description: After completing Prison of Ice and actually thawing Anya, speak with her in Harrogath. Claim permanent +10 resistance to all six damage channels and a separate personalization charge in Quests. Her two optional trades each cost 40 Scrap and 2000 Rune Shards, once per character.

objectives.description: Speak with Anya in Harrogath after completing Prison of Ice and actually thawing her.

quests.name: Qual-Kehk's Warband
quests.description: Qual-Kehk offers Barbarian warriors to fight at your side after the freed prisoners return to Harrogath.

objectives.description: Hire a Barbarian Warrior.

quests.name: Malah's Elixir
quests.description: Recover five distinct Frost Lichens in the Ancients' Way on Normal. Claim in your journal to exchange all five for XP and +10 effective Vitality after the ordinary soft cap, without changing allocated points or restoring Life.

objectives.description: Recover 5 Frost Lichens in the Ancients' Way.

quests.name: Nihlathak's Treasure
quests.description: After freeing Anya and defeating Nihlathak in Crystalline Passage, recover his hidden relic there. Keep it and claim Cain’s XP and Mara’s Kaleidoscope separately in Quests.

objectives.description: Recover Nihlathak's relic.

quests.name: Blood Moor Cull
quests.description: Accept this contract, then clear every wave in Blood Moor on Normal in a new manual battle. Claim 1 Gem Shard in Quests, then choose Repeat for another cull. Battle XP and loot are separate.

objectives.description: After Accept or Repeat, complete one new Normal manual clear of Blood Moor.

quests.name: Rocky Waste Cull
quests.description: Accept this contract, then clear every wave in Rocky Waste on Normal in a new manual battle. Claim 1 Gem Shard in Quests, then choose Repeat for another cull. Battle XP and loot are separate.

objectives.description: After Accept or Repeat, complete one new Normal manual clear of Rocky Waste.

quests.name: Spider Forest Cull
quests.description: Accept this contract, then clear every wave in Spider Forest on Normal in a new manual battle. Claim 1 Gem Shard in Quests, then choose Repeat for another cull. Battle XP and loot are separate.

objectives.description: After Accept or Repeat, complete one new Normal manual clear of Spider Forest.

quests.name: Outer Steppes Cull
quests.description: Accept this contract, then clear every wave in Outer Steppes on Normal in a new manual battle. Claim 1 Gem Shard in Quests, then choose Repeat for another cull. Battle XP and loot are separate.

objectives.description: After Accept or Repeat, complete one new Normal manual clear of Outer Steppes.

quests.name: Bloody Foothills Cull
quests.description: Accept this contract, then clear every wave in Bloody Foothills on Normal in a new manual battle. Claim 1 Gem Shard in Quests, then choose Repeat for another cull. Battle XP and loot are separate.

objectives.description: After Accept or Repeat, complete one new Normal manual clear of Bloody Foothills.
